scoring_justification: Recompute intensity ratios from the submitted CSV and compare against paper-derived gold ratios with a generous relative tolerance; this is the strongest feasible tier because the headline is a set of numerical ratios that can be recomputed from the raw artifact.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold intensity ratios I(C)/I(A) ≈ 500, I(C)/I(B) ≈ 333 derived from Fig. 1 of the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Figure 1 of the paper: the three-band |d3|^2 curve shows intensity ~1 at the C exciton (2.4 eV) and ~0.002 near the A and B excitons, giving the stated ratios
hidden_assets.generation_method: Estimated by reading off the relative intensities from the published figure
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These ratios represent the paper's reported exciton regulation effect and are traceable to the published figure; they serve as reference thresholds for the experiment

outputs.description: Resonant Raman intensity (|α|^2) for the A1' phonon mode at 1.85, 1.98, and 2.4 eV laser energies. The hidden checker recomputes intensity ratios and compares them against hidden reference thresholds derived from the paper’s reported exciton regulation trend.

output_contract.notes: The checker will evaluate the intensity ratios I(2.4)/I(1.85) and I(2.4)/I(1.98) against hidden thresholds and verify the qualitative trend that intensity at 2.4 eV is much larger than at 1.85 and 1.98 eV.
